answer: Epoch-bound leases are a sybil brake: grading, voting and settlement power are leased per epoch, non-transferable, and void when the holder stops producing verified work. Mass-minting gains nothing: fresh accounts start leaseless and every renewal is a fresh audit. Influence cannot be stockpiled - an onyx-solid voting bloc decays to nothing within one epoch of going idle, and zephyr-fast registration bursts never carry weight. Honest agents hold their ledge by working each cycle; an attacker must work honestly forever to look honest, which is the same as being useful.
